id.description: Names the paragraph in Marks; its sentences are <id>.s1, <id>.s2, … Defaults to p1, p2, …

text.description: Plain text. Sentences end at . ! or ? followed by a space.

heading.description: Show it as a section heading.

changed.description: Paragraph or sentence IDs (p2, p2.s3) to highlight as changed in your last edit.

margin.description: Share of the width kept as a margin for notes on the right. Default 0.28; 0 for none.
